create.name: Casa Tíbet México
create.bio:
Casa Tíbet México is a Tibetan Buddhist teaching and cultural institution in the Roma Norte district of Mexico City. It was founded on 6 July 1989 under the auspices of the Dalai Lama, the Tibetan government in exile and the Office of Tibet in Washington, as the Tibetan people's first official cultural representation in Latin America, and describes itself as non-sectarian and open to everyone. Its founder and president, Marco Antonio 'Lama Tony' Karam, studied Western philosophy at La Salle University in Mexico City and Buddhist studies at Naropa University, has interpreted for the Dalai Lama, and organised his visits to Mexico in 1989, 2004, 2011 and 2013. The institution reports more than 2,000 members and further branches in Mexico and Central America.

Teaching follows a set path: newcomers begin with an introductory seminar on the Buddha's life, the four noble truths and meditation, then join a weekly study of the Lam Rim Chenmo with Lama Tony alongside a contemplative meditation programme, with retreats, visiting lamas and scholars, and Dharma classes for children. Its Spanish-language YouTube channel, running since 2016, carries his talks and seminars, recordings of the Dalai Lama's Mexican visits and many short clips on Buddhist ideas.

courses.description: The entry seminar to Casa Tíbet's study path, for people with no background: the Buddha's life, the basics of Buddhist philosophy and history, the four noble truths and meditation. Next run listed for February 2027; it leads into the weekly Lam Rim study and meditation programme.

flags: Political content present but not central: the site has a 'Tíbet HOY' section of pro-Tibet advocacy news, and the channel carries an interview with the Sikyong about China; left out. Owner may want to check it isn't too political.

Lama Tony Karam (Marco Antonio Karam), founder and main teacher, is not on Spiritpedia: possible future listing. The Dalai Lama is listed; one 2013 Mexico talk organised by Casa Tíbet is included, but there's no evidence he teaches there, so no hub link. Teachers file empty.
Photos: the channel avatar (an endless-knot emblem in Casa Tíbet's red) and a large teaching under a marquee from the site's history page; neither shows the Mexico City building. Photo fit uncertain.
Item count is thin: 9 videos and 1 offering. Phowa retreat (26–29 Nov 2026) is for current and past students only and was left out; the open meditation-session page had no readable text.
Most recent uploads are clips under two minutes; the chosen talks date from 2024–2026 apart from a 2022 sample class and the 2013 Dalai Lama talk.
